snippet.title: Weave & Wander: Devlog #1 – Story, Web-Building, Upgrades & the HUB
snippet.description:
One of the biggest updates yet for Weave & Wander, the cute spider game I'm making in Unreal Engine 5!

After being stuck on the story and the game loop for a while, I think I've finally figured out what this game is about.

Wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4532850/Weave__Wander

Join our Discord here:
https://discord.gg/R7ASjeFhp

Playtesting is opening up very soon – keep an eye out!

Any feedback, ideas or thoughts are more than welcome. Every comment helps me make Weave & Wander better.

#indiedev #gamedev #unrealengine5 #devlog #weaveandwander
